additional_info.body:
Dear Guillaume Barcelo,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Abhinav
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P0 170001100
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
OC66Mh
Problem Description
: Remote and physically on-site reboot inconclusive
Troubleshooting
:
We have checked the charger on SCB and found it to be offline and tried to fetch the logs not reflected. Since we are unable to take any remote action, we kindly request you to schedule a site intervention.
Please inform us at least one day in advance so that a team member can be available for assistance.
Before proceeding with troubleshooting, please ensure that the charger and router are powered on by the source. If the issue persists after the healthy supply, consider the following potential causes:
Internet Issues with the Siemens Router:
The WAN may have switched from Cellular to Ethernet due to the failover function.
A
hard reset from OCPP
(if connected to an OCPP server) or a local reboot might restore connectivity.
Mobile Network Issues:
SIM card may be disabled or expired.
Monthly data volume might be exhausted.
Signal strength could be weak due to changing radio conditions.
In M2M contracts, the IP might not be enabled.
Backend-Related Issues:
Changes in backend settings affecting the charger.
OCPP server on the backend may be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues:
Router may have switched to the wrong network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Potential hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Additionally, please bring a spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable during the intervention in case a replacement is needed. If the issue persists even after verifying the spare router, SIM, and Ethernet cable, they should proceed with carrying a Cfast and performing a restore configuration. But make sure that all above points has been verified.
For future reference, your case number is
0412317
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
